SOURCE_UNREGISTERED.remedy: Register a source descriptor before its first sample.

EYE_UNSPECIFIED.message: The observation does not identify an eye.
EYE_UNSPECIFIED.remedy: Declare left, right or combined when the source provides that identity; never infer it from coordinates.

CONFIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.message: The source supplies validity without a scalar confidence.
CONFIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.remedy: Keep confidence null and use the source validity flag; do not manufacture a probability.

SOURCE_RATE_DEVIATION.message: Observed capture cadence differs from the declared rate.
SOURCE_RATE_DEVIATION.remedy: Inspect missing samples, source configuration and timestamp units. Register a new source ID for a changed acquisition profile.

SOURCE_GAP.message: A capture gap exceeds the expected sampling interval.
SOURCE_GAP.remedy: Keep the gap in the recording; inspect tracker loss or transport buffering.

OUT_OF_ORDER.message: A sample arrived behind a newer capture timestamp.
OUT_OF_ORDER.remedy: Use capture timestamps and an appropriate reorder/history budget; do not replace them with receipt time.

PRESENTATION_GAP.message: Per-frame presentation logging contains a timing gap.
PRESENTATION_GAP.remedy: Record each displayed intermediate state or explicitly choose change-only logging for a static state.

HISTORY_EXPIRED.message: The required presentation history is unavailable.
HISTORY_EXPIRED.remedy: Increase maxFrames or persist the complete source log for offline reconstruction.

CLOCK_UNCERTAIN.message: Clock uncertainty exceeds the configured bound.
CLOCK_UNCERTAIN.remedy: Measure clock alignment and drift or set a justified tolerance; do not guess the offset.

FUTURE_CAPTURE.message: Capture time is later than receipt beyond its uncertainty.
FUTURE_CAPTURE.remedy: Check seconds/milliseconds/microseconds and the clock origin before using this source.

SURFACE_MISMATCH.message: The exposure-time layout epoch does not match the retained surface.
SURFACE_MISMATCH.remedy: Tag samples with layout context at exposure and record orientation/window changes.

GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE.message: A 3D observation cannot be projected into the registered display.
GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE.remedy: Provide measured origin, coordinate frame and display pose. A direction alone cannot establish a display crossing.

RECORDING_TRUNCATED.message: The in-memory raw log has reached its retention limit.
RECORDING_TRUNCATED.remedy: Persist source chunks before rollover or use a larger explicit recording budget.

BINOCULAR_PARTIAL.message: A declared binocular capture contains a missing or invalid eye.
BINOCULAR_PARTIAL.remedy: Retain independent validity for each eye; do not fill one eye from the other or from a fused estimate.

SURFACE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.message: Scene-camera coordinates have no declared mapping to the stimulus surface.
SURFACE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.remedy: Use registered surface data, an explicit calibrated mapping, or a measured 3D display plane.

VENDOR_TIMESTAMP_ESTIMATE.message: The vendor timestamp is an estimate rather than a verified exposure time.
VENDOR_TIMESTAMP_ESTIMATE.remedy: Preserve the timestamp provenance and measure its uncertainty for the experiment.

CALLBACK_FAILED.message: A diagnostics callback raised an exception.
CALLBACK_FAILED.remedy: Handle errors in the observer; diagnostic delivery must not interrupt data acquisition.

REUSED_EYE_SAMPLE.message: A vendor binocular packet reused an already emitted eye sample.
REUSED_EYE_SAMPLE.remedy: Keep one independent observation per eye exposure; retain the vendor aggregate separately if required.

DISPLAY_LAYOUT_REQUIRED.message: Full-display gaze has no recorded display-to-viewport layout.
DISPLAY_LAYOUT_REQUIRED.remedy: Record display dimensions and the viewport offset in consistent logical units.

EXPOSURE_TIME_REQUIRED.message: Only host receipt time is available for this source.
EXPOSURE_TIME_REQUIRED.remedy: Preserve the original capture timestamp. Receipt-only records are retained but excluded from capture-time attention analysis.
